notes: The CanadaBuys page returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so I didn't open it. The only content I saw is a search-result summary of the notice. It gives the value, term and date but no 6000/X Plus split, no validated-assay justification and no price terms. The notice is from 2023 and I found no follow-on award. how_to_mine: Open the page in a normal browser, since automated fetch is blocked. Read the justification section for any wording on why 6000 consumables continue. Then search CanadaBuys for a 2024-2026 PHSA or BC Cancer follow-on notice, using 'Illumina' with 'NovaSeq' or 'sequencing reagents', and compare value and wording with this one. Check BC Bid, the BC Cancer Genome Sciences Centre and the PHSA 'File # PHSA 9648' reference for a related notice.
